stem:
Padma dissolves 5 spoons of salt in 250 mL of water. Qasim dissolves 2 spoons of salt in 250 mL of water. Both stir until all the salt dissolves.

Which comparison is correct?

options.text: Padma has more solute in the same amount of solvent, so her solution is more concentrated.
Qasim has less solute, so his solution is more concentrated.
Both solutions have the same concentration because both use 250 mL of water.
Padma's solution is more concentrated because her glass looks fuller.

teacher.key_rationale: For the same fixed amount of solvent, more dissolved solute means a more concentrated solution. Padma dissolved more salt in the same 250 mL, so hers is more concentrated. Equal water volume alone does not equalize concentration.
